title: Document Security and Operational Constraints for Browser Python Execution
description: Document and validate execution boundaries for client-side Python: no server execution path, expected browser sandbox limits, network behavior expectations, and fallback behavior when Pyodide/CDN load fails. Clarify that security defaults are browser-sandbox only and execution features are disabled by default until admins opt in. Document the combined markdown runtime settings model shared with Mermaid and enforce the policy that Viewer-role users cannot run executable code blocks. Align docs and About dependency listing with runtime asset decisions (CDN+SRI default, admin-overridable settings).
